_doc: R3 P1 gate B — REVIEWED shrink entries: a baseline site (contract/p1-hits.json) that an enforced run legitimately no longer reaches, with the reason. A stale entry (the site is reached again, or is not in the baseline) is RED. nondeterministic: reviewed sites whose reach is a deliberate race in the product — neither required nor growth.

nondeterministic.reason: createOrder's identity-shadow sample (index.js ~1269): the response is never held — the shadow result's `status` is read ONLY if the shadow check already settled, else the sample is 'dropped' (a deliberate race). Reached in most runs; missed under CPU load (seen once in the full emulator sweep, reproduced 1 of 3 runs under 6 busy loops).
